title: LADA Y vs Warriors, Nov 16
notes: Renton, the renton2nov camera rolled about 1 degree (as on TK's Nov 15), run as renton2nov. We wore white at home, bench on the right; nets by the rule, the opening faceoffs and the creases, all agreeing. The Warriors wore black with white numbers and gold trim; their #28 was read 80 times and left out. YouTube asked for its bot check, so the video came down with Firefox's cookies.

Played (the sheet's 11 skaters and Hilfer #31 in goal): Kondratenko #12, Ber #14, Petrov #18, Yafunyaev #29, Akulov #37, Unuchek #49, Shakhov #78, Podkorytov #82, Lisitsyn #83, Olyanich #89, Barkov #97. Absent: Sokolov #4, Belousenko #11, Belousenko #13, Lisitsyn #32, Fisenko #58, Beregovoy #67 and #87, Lisitsyn #70, Mischenko #72, Bronnikov #74. No subs. The 262 reads of "4" were Ber's 14 (BER on the nameplates), and the 53 of "68" Olyanich's 89.

Periods from the board's clock (all three ran out; the board was dark for most of the first 21 s of the 1st and 2nd, so those starts are estimates, consistent with an 18:00 running clock). The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd (their minors 3:00 on the board) and stopped at whistles in the 3rd.

Goal times from the goal checkers, scorers from the sheet: Ber #14 at P2 1:00 on the power play, from Barkov #97 and Akulov #37, jammed in at the near post; Barkov's pass wasn't seen, but two lineup checkers had him on the ice at the goal. Their six: #31 Moreland at P1 7:05, #5 Lauzon at P2 10:55, #4 Simon at P2 6:57 (the board's clock read 7:00 as it went in), #77 Baldwin at P3 16:56 (the trailer on #28's breakaway, who reads plainly #17 on the full-resolution replay frames; no #77 was seen near the net, and the Warriors do have a #17), #4 Simon at P3 8:49 (a goalmouth scramble; the shooter's number unreadable, maybe a two-digit one like 12), and #12 Bussiere at P3 6:40 on the power play (its time moved to 55:52 of the video, when the clock froze at 6:40, so the replay runs past the puck going in). No puck was seen crossing the line on any of the seven; each time is the last jam. On Ber's goal Akulov's stick was in the crease at the near post at the same moment, so who touched it last can't be seen. The sheet stands on every scorer.

Clips: goals 1, 5 and 7 against came off carries the tracker missed, so their camera follows a trace walked along the detections from the carry's start to the jam (scratch/clips/traces, in clip_args.json); goal-5's and goal-7's traces begin 3 s before the carry so the replay opens on the carrier. Four rounds of the clip checker; goal-5 was left as cut though the tool asked for the credited #77, since the replay shows the player who jammed it in.

Penalties: theirs, #12 Bussiere tripping Lisitsyn at P2 16:07 (3:00 on the board though the sheet says 2), no goal on our power play; #4 Simon cross-checking at P2 3:50, which the sheet has as a double minor but the board ran as one minor (3:00), ended by Ber's goal. Ours, Akulov #37 tripping at P3 8:11, 2:00, ended by Bussiere's power-play goal (kill 53:58-55:53 of the video, the whistle to the goal).

The lineup was checked by eye at every window the solver flagged, in three rounds: 39 on/off spans (9 in the 1st, 24 in the 2nd, 6 in the 3rd), most for slow changes in the stoppages after goals and for pieces that swapped between players at the bench door. The second a fresh #12 and #49 stepped on after Ber's goal (between 36:58 and 37:02 of the video, the play stopped) was left unchecked. None was set by hand.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 7:05: Warriors' #31 Moreland from #12 Bussiere, jammed in at our left post after a drive to the net left our goalie down at the far post, 0-1
2nd period, clock 10:55: Warriors' #5 Lauzon, jammed in from the goal line at our left post in a scramble with our goalie down, 0-2
2nd period, clock 7:00: Warriors' #4 Simon, drives in from the slot and jams it in at our crease with our goalie down, 0-3
2nd period, clock 1:00: on the power play, Ber #14 from Barkov #97 and Akulov #37: Ber comes off the wall along the goal line and jams it in at the near post with their goalie down, 1-3

3rd period, clock 16:56: Warriors' #77 Baldwin from #12 Bussiere, off a breakaway: #28 carries it the length of the ice and is stopped at the crease, and the trailer crashes the net and jams the loose puck in with our goalie down, 1-4
3rd period, clock 8:49: Warriors' #4 Simon from #9 Li and #12 Bussiere, jammed in at our right post at the end of a long goalmouth scramble with our goalie down, 1-5

3rd period, clock 6:40: Warriors' #12 Bussiere from #8 Snorsky and #9 Li, on the power play, #8 carries it in down the right side and crashes our net, and it's jammed in from the pile in the crease with our goalie down, 1-6
2nd period, clock 16:07: Warriors' #12 Bussiere, tripping Lisitsyn (#83) as they skated up the far boards in their zone, 3 minutes on the board (the sheet says 2), our power play
2nd period, clock 3:50: Warriors' #4 Simon, cross-checking one of ours into the left boards in our zone, 3 minutes on the board (the sheet has a double minor), our power play; Ber's goal ended it
3rd period, clock 8:11: tripping with the stick along the far boards just left of center, 2 minutes; Bussiere scored on the power play during it
